name: Maricopa
seo_title: Maricopa Christmas Events for Kids 2026: 2 Events, 2 Free
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Maricopa, AZ: Merry Copa at Copper Sky with tree lighting and trackless train, plus a free Living Nativity.
lede: Maricopa celebrates Christmas with a free city festival at Copper Sky Regional Park, a living nativity at a local church and a resident light contest.
celebrates: The City of Maricopa calls Merry Copa the biggest event of the holiday season, a free celebration at Copper Sky Regional Park with shops, food trucks and the official lighting of the tree. The city's Merry Copa message lists Santa's Vendor Village, a ride on the trackless train for kids, free hot cocoa and pictures with Santa Claus. Community of Hope Church holds a free Living Nativity with live characters, animals and carolers, and inMaricopa invites residents to register for Holiday Homes on Parade, a free lights contest with an interactive map.
lastyear: On December 6, 2025, Copper Sky turned into a winter wonderland as Maricopa celebrated the Christmas season with its annual Merry Copa event, according to a Pinal Central photo gallery. The City of Maricopa described the 2025 event as a festive celebration with shops, food trucks and the official lighting of the tree, held from 5 to 8 pm at Copper Sky Regional Park, and thanked residents on social media afterward.
facts: The city calls Merry Copa Maricopa's favorite annual holiday event and a celebration of wintertime holidays for the entire family. Its schedule has put the tree lighting late in the evening, after shopping and food trucks, so the tree is the grand finale. Maricopa also holds a Holiday Homes on Parade contest through inMaricopa, which is open to residents of Maricopa, Hidden Valley and Thunderbird Farm and has free registration.
trains: Maricopa's train moment is the trackless train ride that the city lists among the Merry Copa attractions for kids. For real rails, the Mesa Santa Express carries families on a decorated Valley Metro light rail car in Mesa each December, and the Arizona Railway Museum in Chandler and the Phoenix Trolley Museum in Phoenix are the nearest railroad museums. Both are a drive from Maricopa.
train_links: A railroad museum in Chandler with historic train cars.
A trolley and streetcar museum at 1117 Grand Avenue in Phoenix.
traditions: The city's free holiday festival at Copper Sky Regional Park ends with the tree lighting.
Shops and local vendors set up at Merry Copa for holiday gift shopping.
Community of Hope Church presents live characters, animals and carolers.
Residents decorate homes for a free lights contest with an interactive map.
kidfact: At Merry Copa, kids can ride a trackless train and take pictures with Santa Claus.
faq: Yes. The City of Maricopa lists Merry Copa as free, and the city's 2026 message says parking at this year's event is free. The evening is a family celebration with shops, food trucks, hot cocoa, pictures with Santa Claus and the official tree lighting.

Merry Copa takes place at Copper Sky Regional Park, 44345 W Martin Luther King Jr Blvd in Maricopa. The city prints the park address on its event page and posts a schedule with the event start, the tree lighting and the event end.
Can kids meet Santa in Maricopa?

Yes. The city's Merry Copa message promises pictures with Santa Claus, plus a touch-a-truck, interactive installations and a ride on the trackless train for kids. Check the event page for the hours of each activity before you go.
Is there a living nativity in Maricopa?

Community of Hope Church presents Living Nativity Maricopa, which brings the first Christmas to life with live characters, animals and carolers. The church says the immersive experience is free and open to everyone, with a light snack for guests.
What is Holiday Homes on Parade?

inMaricopa runs Holiday Homes on Parade, a lights contest open to residents of Maricopa, Hidden Valley and Thunderbird Farm. Registration is free, and the publication posts an interactive map so families can plan an evening tour of the decorated homes.
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Maricopa for 2026, and here is what he found: 2 family events, 2 of them free. The magic runs from December 5 (Merry Copa, with its tree lighting at Copper Sky Regional Park) through December 19 (Living Nativity Maricopa). We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Maricopa

  • 2 free events: Merry Copa and Living Nativity Maricopa
  • Meet Santa: pictures with Santa at Merry Copa (December 5)
  • Tree lightings: the official tree lighting at Merry Copa (December 5)
  • Trains: a trackless train ride for kids at Merry Copa
  • Season: December 5 to December 19
